top.line: Consolidating PrompTugal.news's public data into one data site, then focused newsrooms on top.
top.para: Each run by an agentic team, each a possible company.

in-short.line: Live data people like; one data site; code vs agents vs tokens; six focused newsrooms; journalism.

have.line: Hourly IPMA and flight data for 18 places, the storm's 34 datasets, place files, OpenAPI, observability.

data.line: Per public source: a collector as code, a vault, an API, provenance and a card.

tokens.line: Record how much is code, agents and people, and the tokens; mostly code means nearly free to run.

verticals.line: Agriculture, investors, the sea, fire, tourism and AI, each a sub-brand run by an agentic team.

journalism.line: The data exists in public; turning it into information people use is journalism's job.
journalism.para: Affordable again with agents and code.

next.line: PrompTugal.news's conductor is briefed: data site, vaults, APIs, provenance, costs, and observability.

limits.line: Plans, not built; token figures are the storm's own; source terms decide reuse.

sources.line: An inventory of the PrompTugal.news repository, IPMA open data and earlier articles.
